title: Unveiling the main sequence to starburst transition region with a sample of intermediate redshift luminous infrared galaxies
question: Establish the molecular gas distribution, star formation efficiency, dynamics, and star formation triggers of intermediate-redshift (0.28 < z < 0.44) U/LIRGs located in the transition region between regular main sequence star-forming galaxies and starbursts.

data.sensitivity: 0.91 mJy/beam per 20 km s^-1 channel (CDFS1 ALMA); 0.55 - 0.71 mJy/beam (NOEMA targets)

what.value: Parent sample selection, L_IR, dust temperatures T_dust, single-dish CO measurements, and SPIRE-FTS spectra.

evidence.quote: Our six targets, FLS02 (2 merging galaxies), CDFS1 (2 merging galaxies), SWIRE7 and SWIRE5, were selected from the sample of intermediate redshift U/LIRGs presented in (cite: magdis_far-infrared_2014) (hereafter M14), (cite: rigopoulou_herschel_2014) and (cite: pereira-santaella_optical_2019) (hereafter PS19).

what.value: Ground-based I-band integral field spectroscopy, optical images, SFR_IR, and [NII] 6583 A / Halpha (N2) ratios for gas-phase oxygen abundance.

evidence.quote: The IR star formation rate from (cite: pereira-santaella_optical_2019).
The gas phase oxygen abundance obtained from the N2 ratio presented in (cite: pereira-santaella_optical_2019).
For the metallicity of our sample, we use our sample’s \[NII\] 6583 Å / H$\alpha$ ratios (N2) reported in PS19 and converted these to 12 + log(O/H) using the (cite: pettini_\[o_2004) correlation.

what.value: Comparison sample of warm starbursting ULIRGs at 0.2 < z < 0.6 with CO molecular gas masses and SFEs.

evidence.loc: Molecular Gas and SFR at 0.2 < z < 0.6
evidence.quote: (cite: combes_galaxy_2011) presented CO observations for a sample of ULIRGs at 0.2 $<$ z $<$ 0.6 which were previously detected at 60 $\mu$m from IRAS and ISO observations.

evidence.loc: Molecular Gas and SFR at 0.2 < z < 0.6
evidence.quote: Molecular gas masses and SFEs have been determined in both the cold LIRG and warm ULIRG samples ((cite: combes_galaxy_2011), (cite: lee_fine_2017)), and these results along with our sample are plotted in Figure 7.

what.value: Comparison sample of cold LIRGs at 0.25 < z < 0.65 with molecular gas masses and SFEs.

evidence.loc: Molecular Gas and SFR at 0.2 < z < 0.6
evidence.quote: (cite: lee_fine_2017) investigated a sample of LIRGs, at 0.25 $<$ z $<$ 0.65, that have lower luminosities than our sample (log(L$_{\rm IR}$ / L$_{\odot}$) = 11.2 - 11.6) and are located on, or just above, the upper boundary of the MS (hereafter referred to as cold LIRGs).

recipe.goal: Create CO(3-2) and continuum intensity (0th moment) maps and measure total CO fluxes
recipe.method: Apply a 3sigma cut in each channel of the naturally weighted CO(3-2) cube and integrate across the total line width; apply a 3sigma cut to the continuum map.
key_parameters: 3sigma threshold per channel for CO(3-2) and 3sigma cut on continuum map
assumptions: Rest ~0.9 mm continuum arises from Rayleigh-Jeans dust emission and targets are star-formation dominated.

recipe.goal: Compute CO(3-2) line luminosities and molecular gas masses
recipe.method: Convert integrated CO(3-2) flux to line luminosity L'_CO(3-2) using Solomon et al. (1997) formula, then multiply by metallicity-dependent conversion factor alpha_CO(3-2)(Z) = alpha_0 * chi(Z) * R_1-3.
assumptions: H0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7; Chabrier (2003) IMF; chi(Z) = 1 for SWIRE7.

recipe.goal: Calculate star formation surface densities, molecular gas surface densities, SFE, and depletion times
recipe.method: Measure star-forming area A_cont from pixels with SNR > 3sigma in continuum map, mask CO(3-2) cube to A_cont and integrate over velocity channels with no threshold, then compute Sigma_mol = M_mol(masked)/A_cont, Sigma_SFR = SFR_IR/A_cont, and tau_dep = 1/SFE.
key_parameters: 3sigma continuum contour mask A_cont; 300 km s^-1 assumed linewidth for SWIRE7 3sigma upper limit
assumptions: SFR_IR approximates total SFR; for FLS02-S A_cont equals the CO(3-2) emitting region; for FLS02 system SFR_IR is apportioned between N and S by relative continuum flux; all CDFS1 SFR_IR arises from CDFS1-W.

recipe.goal: Fit 3D tilted-ring kinematic models to the CO(3-2) data cubes
recipe.method: Use 3DBAROLO SEARCH algorithm to mask emission and fit a 3D tilted-ring thin-disk model convolved with the synthesized beam to derive v_rot and sigma_gas.
key_parameters: SEARCH 5sigma initial cut with 3sigma adjoining threshold; ring width 0.3'' - 0.4''; centre fixed to continuum peak; v_rad = 0; v_sys = 0 at centre; PA and inclination fixed after initial guess; v_rot and sigma_gas free
assumptions: Thin disk scale height and zero radial velocity.

recipe.goal: Compare sample M_mol, SFE, and L_IR with intermediate-z cold LIRGs and warm ULIRGs
recipe.method: Combine sample with Combes et al. (2011) warm ULIRGs and Lee et al. (2017) cold LIRGs and compute Pearson correlation between log(SFE) and log(L_IR).

answer_key.quantity: CO(3-2) integrated flux upper limit S_CO*Delta_v (SWIRE7)
Total molecular gas mass upper limit M_mol (SWIRE7)
Pearson correlation coefficient rho for log(SFE) vs log(L_IR)

evidence.loc: Molecular Gas and SFR at 0.2 < z < 0.6
evidence.quote: There is a statistically significant strong positive correlation for log(SFE) - log(L$_{\rm IR}$) of the three samples, with a Pearson’s $\rho$ = 0.91 (p-value < 0.001).

not_stated_but_needed: Exact CASA and GILDAS software versions used for reduction and imaging
Stopping threshold / niter and masking strategy used in CASA TCLEAN and GILDAS CLEAN
Specific channel ranges selected as line-free for UVCONTSUB and velocity integration windows for each source
Continuum RMS noise values (muJy/beam) for the continuum maps of each target
Exact ring radii and number of rings used in 3DBAROLO for CDFS1-W and SWIRE5
missing_for_reproduction: NOEMA raw/calibrated visibility data (projects W19BV and W20GC are only available upon request, not in a public archive as stated)
Exact continuum map RMS values needed to define the 3sigma contour masks A_cont
Exact velocity integration ranges and line-free channel ranges for each galaxy
Exact 3DBAROLO parameter files (ring radii, number of rings, systemic velocities, and centre pixel coordinates)
score_reason: The ALMA dataset (2016.1.00896.S) is publicly available and the analytical equations, conversion factors, pixel sizes, channel widths, and 3DBAROLO setup are clearly described, but 3 of the 4 systems rely on non-public NOEMA data and exact continuum RMS values and integration windows are not tabulated.
rediscovery_reason: For the ALMA target CDFS1-W, the archival data (2016.1.00896.S) are public, the reduction and analysis steps (CASA pipeline + UVCONTSUB + TCLEAN natural weighting + moment masking + 3DBAROLO fit) are straightforward, and key numeric outputs (S_CO*dv, M_mol, A_cont, tau_dep, V_rot, sigma_gas) are explicitly tabulated.
